in_hebrew.name: Radmira
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Radmira הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Slavic name Radimir, meaning 'little Radmir'. Radmir itself is composed of two elements: 'rad', meaning 'wealth', and 'mir', meaning 'peace'. Thus, Radmira represents the peaceful wealth that nurtures and protects.
